notes.title: Content Update!
notes.notes:
Based on user feedback, we've added in a few options to make gameplay better (option to disable background camera rotation, etc.). We've also polished up the levels and mechanics a bit to make things run a lot smoother!

Happy puzzling!

notes.title: Meld Price Change to $9.99
notes.notes:
Hi Folks!

In an effort to provide all users with a wide and continuing level of content, we are dropping the price of Meld to $9.99! Tell your friends and share the game!

Thanks!

Danny Jugan
Lead Developer
Axis Games
